response_options.label: Send the F-15s 1,500 miles to the PLO headquarters at Hammam Chott, refuelling in mid-air
response_options.desc: The longest strike since Entebbe and Osirak, on the headquarters south of Tunis that Israel linked to the Larnaca killings. Larger lessons for the air force; the diplomatic cost as history records it (Security Council resolution 573).

cite.quote: They flew 1,500 miles to their target and the same distance home, a total of 3,000 miles during which the Israeli jets refueled in mid-air.

response_options.label: A narrower strike on the Force 17 offices that Israel blamed for Larnaca
response_options.desc: A smaller strike package: half the Standing losses abroad, smaller lessons learned.

cite.quote: Israel holds Force 17 responsible for the murder of three Israelis aboard a yacht in Larnaca, Cyprus on September 25, Yom Kippur.

response_options.label: Carry it out with the aircraft already assigned, without extra funding
response_options.desc: No extra money for tankers and training: the strike goes ahead as history records, but the forces learn less (Readiness lesson -1). Arafat was not at the headquarters at the time.

cite.quote: But Arafat was not there at the time.
